questions: What exact definition of “progression” should be used (e.g., arithmetic, geometric, constant difference, or any other type)?
If a progression is defined as arithmetic, must the common difference be an integer, or can it be fractional?
Should the sequence be considered a progression if all elements are equal (i.e., common difference zero)?
Are sequences of length N = 2 always considered a progression regardless of their values?
Must the progression property hold for the entire sequence, or is it sufficient that any contiguous subsequence of length ≥2 forms a progression?
Should the output be case‑sensitive exactly as “Yes” and “No”, or are other capitalizations acceptable?
Is there any requirement on whitespace or line breaks after the output (e.g., trailing newline)?
Are there any hidden constraints on the values of A_i beyond the given range that could affect the definition (e.g., overflow considerations for computing differences)?
